consigna: Hold a real conversation of at least twenty minutes in English with a person, unprepared, about whatever comes up.
requisitos: A real person, not a chatbot and not a recording.
No preparation: no notes, no rehearsed topic, no vocabulary look-up beforehand.
Do not steer the conversation onto ground you have practised.
microtareas: Mon (2 min).* Arrange the conversation. That is the whole task, and it is the one people skip.
Wed (0 min).* Nothing. Do not prepare.
Fri (5 min).* After the conversation, write the three lines while it is fresh.
autochequeo: Was it at least twenty minutes?
Did I avoid a subject because of the language rather than the content?
Did I write down what broke, or only what went well?
Did I resist the urge to prepare?
